validation: Both worlds match the llama.cpp + candle reference argmax=11 for warm_token=9419 on this tokenizer. World=2 strictly faster than world=1 (75 vs 54 tok/s) — TP scaling is real. World=1 doubles as a bit-exact bisect floor against PP for any future TP regression.
fixes_landed_to_get_here: Bug 2/3 (tp_sharded.rs): TP loader F32->F16 norm + F32->Q8_0 ssm conversions mirroring PP's up_f16/up_q8_0
Bug 4 (tp_slice.rs): FusedQkvParallel slicer was using wrong on-disk layout assumption ([V|K|Q] instead of [Q|K|V])
TP-2d-i2 (tp_sharded.rs): cached OpsRegistry per rank — the dominant decode-time cost
leave_behind: FLAMBEAU_TP_PROBE env-gated probes are kept in tree (forward/tp.rs::debug_probe_*, forward/gdn_tp.rs::debug_probe_*). Set FLAMBEAU_TP_PROBE=1 [+ FLAMBEAU_TP_LAYER_LIMIT=N] to reproduce per-layer + per-rank state dumps. Zero overhead when unset.
notes: First end-to-end-correct execution of TP-0..TP-5b on real silicon.
